domestic_evidence: No public GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved. Company website (https://www.consciousfood.com/pages/about-us) is a product catalogue with India-wide shipping and 'FREE DELIVERY FOR MUMBAI ORDERS' — catalogue/storefront claims are out of scope and do not count as shipment fact. Zaubacorp returned HTTP 403 and Tofler returned HTTP 404 for the CIN guess, so no registry financials were obtained.
note: Export activity is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs records with B/L numbers (7997280, 8937487, 2530442, 1139578, 9572443) across USA, Singapore, New Zealand, Australia and Mauritius, spanning 2025-09-30 to 2026-02-11 — so this is a real, recurring exporter, not a claim. Declared HS 151590 (vegetable fats/oils) is only partially consistent: one confirmed row is ghee under HS 04059020 and another is coconut MCT oil under HS 15131900; the company ships a broad organic food basket (pulses 07139010, spices 09093200, cereal preparations 21069019). Per project rules this is not a rejection ground — the code should be corrected to the actual dominant export HS, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Note the 2025-12-18 row lists the same name as both supplier and buyer (US consignee), which is a related-party/own-brand export, not an arm's-length third-party sale. Domestic supply: no verifiable GST turnover, tender or contract evidence found in public sources within the tool budget — recorded as unknown, not as confirmed. Revenue and export volume figures: null (not public on free views; not invented).
